patterns.component_pattern: React functional components with TypeScript props interfaces
patterns.styling_pattern: Tailwind CSS with custom CSS variables for theming
patterns.button_pattern: Uses cva (class-variance-authority) for button variants: primary, secondary, outline, ghost
patterns.card_pattern: Card components use rounded-2xl with surface-card class
patterns.table_empty_state_pattern: Table components define DEFAULT_EMPTY_ICON and accept emptyState prop with icon, title, description, actionHref, actionLabel

existing_implementations.description: Current TableEmptyStateRow shows icon, title, description, and single action button. Multiple table types (BoardsTable, AgentsTable, BoardGroupsTable, SkillPacksTable, GatewaysTable, TagsTable, CustomFieldsTable, MarketplaceSkillsTable) use this pattern.

quick_action_contexts.boards: Quick-create templates for common board types (Kanban, Sprint, Support)
quick_action_contexts.agents: Quick-setup guide with example agent configurations
quick_action_contexts.custom_fields: Field type examples and use cases
